scope: Read-only Intel testbed baseline and existing-owner receive trace; physical switch pairing and control are pending confirmation

capture.method: One path-filtered strace of read syscalls on the existing daemon-owned UART; no second serial opener, writes, firmware changes or service restart
capture.stop_reason: size monitor threshold reached before the 30-second deadline
capture.timing_note: UTC values are API snapshot times surrounding the trace. Elapsed time is measured by the capture wrapper from before tracer launch through post-capture inspection, not exact attach-to-detach time.

limitations: The recorded 146 unsupported-length frames account for the sampled counter increase only; they do not explain the earlier 252 or every historical counter increment.
Unsupported frames are not independently established as valid traffic, and captured records do not provide independent radio FCS verification.
Ptrace perturbs process scheduling, so the capture is unsuitable for RF or UART latency or performance conclusions.
The first recognized record cannot by itself prove the capture began at a UART line boundary; no final partial UART bytes remained.
Raw radio payloads and device identities remain private and are not included here.
Bench switch presence and network membership must be confirmed before pairing or physical control; neither was performed in this capture.
